newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT-ING Barings rates HK Telecom "sell".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ING Barings rates HK Telecom "sell".

text.p: ING Barings said in a recent report that it rated Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd as "sell" following its strong share price performance.

"While we assign a 50:50 probability to a potential shareholding restructuring in favour of a mainland Chinese entity, we see any benefits that may accrue to Hongkong Telecom as long term," said analyst Gautam Kapoor.
In the short term, the idea of a Chinese partner is positive on sentiment and short-term price appreciation is likely, he said.
Investors should focus on the company's fundamentals in a changing regulatory environment in Hong Kong, including the potential loss of its monopoly status, the report said.
"The company could lose 30 percent to 35 percent (of its) marketshare in a period of 12-18 months from the time of its loss of its monopoly status," Kapoor said.
The share closed HK$0.40 higher at HK$14.40 on Monday.
